credits.title: Woman on Fire
credits.overview: Marina lands her first leading role, but the pandemic takes it away from her. Frustrated and lost, she meets a socio-environmental activist who confronts her own prejudices as she decides whether to take to the streets to defend her territory or follow her dream.

credits.overview: A woman is torn between wanting and not wanting.
